Trust centre

Security

Last reviewed 16 September 2026

The site creates QR codes in your browser and has no backend. That keeps the data path small, but it also means the site cannot verify an account or confirm a payment.

Safe use checklist

  • Check the UPI ID before generating and before sharing any QR.
  • Ask the payer to confirm the recipient name and amount shown by their UPI app.
  • Confirm each successful credit in your bank statement or UPI app.
  • Never share a UPI PIN. Entering a UPI PIN authorizes a payment; it is not required to receive money.
  • Do not rely on screenshots or verbal claims as proof of payment.

Technical controls

All QR generation is local. The deployed site uses HTTPS and restrictive response headers. No third party scripts, fonts, analytics, ads, or payment SDKs are loaded.

Limitations

UPI apps and banks may interpret or reject payment links according to their own policies. A generated QR is a payment instruction, not a payment request accepted by a bank and not evidence of settlement.

Report a problem

Please report a suspected vulnerability privately through GitHub's security advisory flow once the repository is available. Do not include real financial details in a public issue.
